text.en:
Now you ask if something is true.
Tu es là. = You are there.
Tu es là ? = Are you there?
The words stay the same.
Your voice goes up at the end.
In writing, a ? appears at the end.

There is a second way to ask.
Start with est-ce que, then say the usual phrase.
Est-ce que tu es à la gare ? = Are you at the train station?
À la gare means “at the train station”.
Est-ce que la porte est ouverte ? = Is the door open?
La porte means “the door”. Ouverte means “open”.

Now you build questions from word tiles.
Say each one in your head with a rising voice.
Elle est prête ? = Is she ready?
Prête means “ready”.
Look for est-ce que at the start of longer questions.
The rest of the phrase stays in order.
